name: DHL
verdict: DHL Group (Deutsche Post AG) is a listed German logistics company, but it is not purely private: KfW Bankengruppe, the state-owned German development bank, holds….
note: Rating note: Judgement call: 17.7% via KfW is a partial, not controlling, state stake, so 'concern' per the rubric. DHL would argue over 78% is free float and it is not state-controlled - which is why it is not 'serious'.
